title: Optimization of Welding Parameters Using an Improved Hill-Climbing Algorithm Based on BP Neural Network for Multi-Bead Weld Smoothness Control.
summary: Two BP neural networks predict bead width/height and flatness from welding inputs; improved hill-climbing optimizes process settings. Experimental evaluation used 17 Box–Behnken designs with fit/residual checks; conclusion bounded to parameter range.
ai_technology: §5.3: two learned BP networks map process inputs to bead geometry and surface flatness; hill-climbing searches predicted responses.
